decision: Define the first executable unit as a lossless lexer plus concrete-syntax parser before semantic lowering
why: Self-hosting parity is only useful when the source representation and byte spans are stable; a typed AST can then be layered without losing tokens

decision: Keep stage0 as the Rust/LLVM seed and stage1 as a Silver source tree under bin/agc and libs/agc
why: Preserves the working compiler while making the new compiler buildable by the old one

decision: Use explicit function pointers and concrete iterators; do not add closures yet
why: The current frontend can use callbacks without introducing capture/drop-flag semantics

decision: Require a real stage0-built stage1 binary in the self-host harness
why: A source tree that is not compiled and executed does not prove the migration boundary

decision: Use an iterative source-module worklist and project imported declarations into the name table
why: Recursive loading exhausted/corrupted the stage1 stack on transitive stdlib graphs; a worklist keeps source ownership explicit

decision: Add CfgSet defaults, --cfg/-O parsing, item gates, and compile-time branch pruning
why: Stage1 must not resolve identifiers in disabled declarations or dead branches

decision: Project typed local binding records over the CST
why: Ownership and borrow passes need declaration origins instead of re-parsing flat token text

decision: Gate semantic status parity separately from exact diagnostics and list deferred artifact inputs
why: Status parity catches regressions now; exact messages require the typed checker and AGM reader
evidence: tests/selfhost/check_semantics.py; 346 std-inclusive files compared, 0 deferred skips

decision: Project launch argument types over the CST and gate exact Send primary diagnostics
why: The first typed expression slice is enough to replace the old literal Rc scan and prove allocator safety

decision: Read supported AGM versions and reject malformed metadata before name resolution
why: Checked-in vendor artifacts and generated module fixtures now participate in semantic parity without an allowlist

decision: Add an explicit stage0 backend seam for stage1 native commands while the Silver backend is ported
why: This preserves Linux correctness/cache behavior and gives the full corpus a real stage1 command boundary without pretending the backend is migrated

decision: Run the complete native corpus through the stage1 command surface
why: The bridge boundary, cache gate, compiler output, runtime exit status, and expected compile failures all match the stage0 baseline

decision: Require cyclic-module and repeated-cache builds in the native parity gate
why: A fresh stage0 cache previously failed cyclic_test while --no-cache succeeded; the gate now prevents that correctness regression from returning
evidence: reproduction: stage0 cyclic_test with fresh XDG_CACHE_HOME; tests/selfhost/check_native_cache.py

decision: Disable root-object reuse until implicit imports are represented in the dependency key
why: Root cache hits omitted std.sys.entry and produced unresolved silver_argc/silver_argv symbols; dependency-module caching remains enabled and correctness is restored

decision: Validate and stage dependency cache artifacts before publishing
why: A crash or corrupt pair must become a cache miss rather than a linker failure or split artifact
evidence: bootstrap/stage0/agc/src/cache_store.rs; cache_store tests; fresh-cache cyclic runs

decision: Split the Silver compiler into a driver crate and reusable frontend library
why: The binary owns command orchestration while LSP and AGSM ports can depend on the library without inheriting driver code
evidence: bin/agc/silver.toml; bin/aglsp/silver.toml; libs/agc/silver.toml; silver.toml; stage0 and stage1 builds

decision: Break the remaining frontend into typed declarations, expressions, ownership, modules, diagnostics, and fixpoint slices
why: Large migrations need one checkable exit condition and a green self-host gate after every slice

decision: Implement canonical TypeTable and TypeId storage with O(1) properties and BitSet collection
why: Replaces ad-hoc CST string comparisons with flat POD types; eliminates drop-flag and recursion overhead in the type layer

decision: Lower CST to flat POD AstExpr/AstStmt and implement unified expression type inference
why: Replaces fragile token scraping across multiple passes with single-pass lowering and bottom-up type inference

decision: Implement structural Place, field-projection overlap, and BitSet-accelerated move/borrow analysis
why: O(1) bitset flags eliminate linear searches for moved locals; structural places distinguish disjoint field borrows

decision: Implement MonomorphCollector with symbol mangling and 256-generation fixpoint cap
why: Deduplicates generic instantiation requests across functions, impls, and structs
evidence: libs/agc/src/frontend/monomorph.ag; stage0 build and selfhost stage gate

decision: Centralize user-facing diagnostic messages and add Levenshtein-based fuzzy typo suggestions
why: Unifies diagnostic wording and enables single-file translation and typo guidance
evidence: libs/agc/src/frontend/messages.ag; stage0 build and selfhost stage gate

decision: Complete full frontend migration of stage1 Silver compiler
why: All 7 frontend completion criteria verified green across 348 stage-gate files and 200 native tests
evidence: bash tests/selfhost/run_stage.sh (348/348 passed); bash tests/selfhost/run_native.sh (200/200 passed)
